name: Michael Lerman
summary: Highly motivated AI-native fast self-learner who isn't afraid to ask questions. Comfortable being independent as much as being a team player. CoffeeScript lover.

bullets: Led the redesign of the main dashboard, simplifying navigation and reducing cognitive load through a more intuitive UX. Built a persistent filtering system that preserved user context, reduced repetitive navigation, and made key product workflows faster and more efficient.

Expanded visual regression testing from design-system components to full product pages by building a Chromatic/Storybook screenshot pipeline, increasing release confidence and catching UI regressions earlier.
Cut production build times by 90% and HMR latency by 40% by migrating the frontend build pipeline from Webpack to Rspack.
Standardized the styling architecture by replacing fragmented CSS approaches with enforced styled-components conventions, improving maintainability and consistency across the product.
Served as a technical interviewer, evaluating candidate skills and contributing to hiring decisions for the engineering team.

Created a local frontend development environment from the ground up using Nginx/Caddy proxy networking, automatic HTTPS, and simplified configuration, enabling faster iteration and a smoother developer experience.
Established AI-ready guardrails through custom ESLint rules that encoded engineering standards, making AI-assisted development safer, more consistent, and easier to review.
Championed a zero-error policy in Sentry, reducing alert fatigue and strengthening the reliability of production monitoring.
Doubled Core Web Vitals performance using React Suspense and code-splitting, as validated by Lighthouse.
Enhanced build process efficiency through an upgrade to Webpack 5 and Vite.
Contributed to internal Design System development in conjunction with UI/UX experts.
Modernized and streamlined development processes by updating CI/CD (Bamboo) pipelines.
Migrated to TanStack Query to implement caching strategies and improve the user experience.
Built a mobile-first application and admin dashboard from scratch using Next.js.
Managed authentication and database operations with Firebase Firestore.
Developed a REST API on Laravel with MySQL, integrated with a third-party lead system.
